A [[Gender/Legends|female]] '''individual''' headed a [[Corvis Minor IV biotechnology firm|biotechnology firm]] based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corvis Minor IV]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], and hired investigators to verify her belief that one of her rivals had stolen her [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]]' work.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=rothc|type=crewskill|Investigation|Criminal Engineering}}</ref>
